title: campanula rotundifolia subsp. willkommii
intro: Campanula rotundifolia subsp. willkommii, commonly known as the alpine bellflower, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the bellflower family. It is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of alpine bellflower include its ability to act as a nervine, calming the nervous system and promoting relaxation, as well as its potential to act as an antispasmodic, reducing muscle tension and spasms. The bioactive constituents of alpine bellflower include glycosides and flavonoids, which are thought to contribute to its medicinal properties.
